`pdf-to-json` reads PDFs made by Microsoft Word and encrypted PDFs that open without a password.

- `pdf-to-json.wasm`: PDFs saved from Word, directly or through Acrobat PDFMaker, came out garbled or with lines missing. Two causes are fixed: fonts whose character map declares two-byte codes are now read one byte at a time, as the PDF standard requires for these fonts, and a page drawn in several content streams is read as one, so text split across them is no longer lost. Encrypted PDFs that open without a password (RC4 40/128-bit, AES-128 and AES-256), common for bank statements and government forms, are now read instead of rejected; a PDF that needs a password returns an error saying so. Document metadata with typographic characters such as em dashes now decodes correctly.

The other modules are unchanged. Every file is built on GitHub from the tagged source, byte-identical to a local `./build.sh`, with `SHA256SUMS` and a signed build attestation.
